PM SVANidhi Portal is live with enhanced loan amount limits. Vendors from Census Towns are also now eligible to avail loans and other benefits under the Scheme || PM SVANidhi Credit Card facility is now available for Second tranche repaid Street Vendors to enhance their working capital limit through a seamless and structured process. || Vendor Mobility (ULB Transfer) facility is now available on PM SVANidhi to enable street vendors to update their ULB details in case of migration to another vending location.

How to Apply... 

Follow 3 STEPs before starting the online Application Process:







1



Check Eligibility

1. Understand the Loan Application requirements





2



Apply Online


2. Make sure your mobile number is linked to your Aadhaar





3



Get Digital Approval

3. Check your eligibility status as per scheme rules

















Notified States/UTs


The scheme is available for beneficiaries
belonging to only those States/UTs which have notified rules and scheme under
Street Vendors (Protection of Livelihood and
Regulation of Street Vending) Act, 2014.




Click To View State Notification














Check your Survey Status


You can check your survey status whether you have been covered in the survey carried out by Urban Local Bodies(ULB)/Municipalities or not and can save your Survey Reference Number(SRN) for future Reference.





Click to check survey status
